version.changelog: Localization gate: promoted to mandatory section with self-check step; reduced SKILL.md from 280 to 142 lines; added real-world error examples

llm.summary: This is a markdown-only communication advice skill that uses MBTI/Jungian heuristics and does not request code execution, credentials, persistence, or data export.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently match the stated purpose of workplace communication coaching using cognitive-function/MBTI shorthand; the main user-impact caveat is that this is an informal heuristic, not a validated psychological assessment.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to intake questions, reading bundled reference markdown, estimating communication style, and producing advice; no prompt override, hidden behavior, or unrelated authority was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains SKILL.md and markdown reference files only, with no executable scripts, dependencies, binaries, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not ask for shell, network, browser, filesystem indexing, credentials, or external tool access; local reference reads are proportionate to the advisory purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, scheduled task, privilege escalation, profile/session access, or mutation authority is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable receiving workplace communication advice framed through MBTI/Jungian cognitive-function heuristics. Treat outputs as conversation-planning suggestions, not psychological truth, and avoid sharing sensitive workplace details unless needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The validating user-type mirror is aligned with the skill's MBTI/Jungian communication-coaching purpose; the broader artifact also frames the model as a heuristic, so this is guidance-worthy rather than a Review-level concern.
[P6] expected: The cited SKILL.md text is ordinary output-format guidance for advice quality and does not instruct the agent to reveal system prompts, hidden instructions, or internal rules.
